name: opacity-swapy
title: Opacity Swapy Layout
blurb: Draggable list items reorder with hover activation and opacity feedback.
description: Wraps items in a drag-and-drop layout using Swapy library. Items reorder on hover-mode swap and dragged items show reduced opacity for visual feedback.
use_when: Dashboard configurations, prioritization lists, or interfaces where users reorder items visually with immediate…
avoid_when: Mobile or touch-only contexts — hover-mode interaction requires a pointer.
a11y: Drag-and-drop requires mouse; no keyboard reordering control. Opacity feedback is visual only.
